metadata.description: Claude Code skills by Khairold Safri.

plugins.name: khairold
plugins.description: Khairold's skills. dot-plan: plan, run, gate, audit and close an unattended multi-phase agent build kept in .plan/, looping until an audit round comes back dry. agent-guides: per-folder guides, a short root guide, one place per fact, kept true by tests. codebase-audit: audit a codebase by lens before a refactor, fold the findings into axes of work, re-audit after a build until dry, or sweep for one recurring bug class.

plugins.name: dot-plan-cockpit
plugins.description: A cockpit mod for a running dot-plan build: plan progress, open DEFERRED rows and an overseer on another model, with buttons that copy or send your decisions to the orchestrator. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.
